title: Grease Trap '99
short_description: Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.
description:
Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

Alone on the night shift in a small-town Highland fish and chip shop in 1999, you start to feel something growing beneath the sticky floor tiles. Between battering fish, deep-frying pizzas and stirring curry sauce for impatient locals, you have to investigate the mystery without letting the orders pile up. PS1 and PS2-inspired low-poly visuals give it a dreamlike, unsettling feel, and it's a short horror experience designed to be finished in under an hour.
